triennialProviderSource.description: Provider identifies CJLS/Eisenberg system with Cohen2020 and Heller2012 amendments. No provider code imported; independent comparison of all divisions to RA source tables remains pending.

editionPolicy: Hebcal section references are validated against UXLC verse records/counts before opening. Source strings and original reading divisions are not normalized or replaced. Missing/unsupported divisions refuse opening. Haftarah/Megillah are reference-only until their text is implemented.
networkPolicy: Only an explicit month load/refresh contacts Hebcal; no geolocation, time-of-day or candle-lighting data requested. Selected month and Israel/Diaspora flag are sent. Up to12 loaded month responses cached locally; four source examples bundled.
